title: Design System: Liner Marketing Landing Page

display.purpose: Hero and major campaign claims only.

label.purpose: Commands, nav, metadata, version markers, terminal states.

elevationMeta.philosophy: Flat, structural depth through tonal layers, hairlines, grid seams, and corner markers.

motion.system: WebGL blocks, rail scans, marquee tracks, progress bars, and terminal cursor blink.
motion.reducedMotion: Animations must become static or settle under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

install-command.description: Dark copyable command pill with selectable code and fixed-width copy state.

file-tree.description: Dark mono artifact panel for mixtape folder output and source structure.

workspace-panel.description: Square dark panel with 1px hairline border, no shadow, optional corner marker.

do: Use orange for commands, active state, progress, proof links, and installation.
Show concrete artifacts: commands, files, source notes, terminal states, folder output, and compiled mixtape details.
Keep command snippets copyable and stable in width.
dont: Do not make Liner look like generic AI tool marketing with pastel gradients, floating chat bubbles, soft cards, and vague productivity claims.
Do not add purple-blue gradients, glassmorphism, decorative orbs, abstract AI sparkle visuals, or bokeh backgrounds.
Do not use em dashes or Not this, but this contrast framing in marketing copy.
